circle.data-tooltip-text: cond is a copy of the caller's value
cond goes out of scope
s acquires ownership of a resource
s is live in a conditional expression
s's resource is mutably borrowed by r; s can't be used while the borrow is live
s's resource is moved into drop, which drops it

• s was moved in at least one branch above, so it can't be used after the branches (until it's assigned again). If the branch that ran didn't move it, its resource is dropped when s goes out of scope.
• s's resource is no longer mutably borrowed

g.data-tooltip-text: s goes out of scope. Its resource is dropped here only if no branch above moved it (Rust tracks this with a runtime drop flag).

polygon.style: fill: var(--rv-drop-notch); stroke: none; pointer-events: none;

g.data-tooltip-text:
• the resource r points to is mutably borrowed by push_str through r; r can't be used while the borrow is live
• push_str reads and writes through r (mutable reborrow — r can't be used until push_str returns)
• push_str no longer borrows the resource r points to
• r's mutable borrow ends
